run_turn_based_example: run the turn_based_example function to play a turn-based game using open_spiel rl_environment
select_actions_random: select random legal actions from observations for a given player in an open_spiel game
create_rl_environment: create an open_spiel rl_environment.Environment for a specified game with optional player configuration
print_iteration_log: print iteration logging information including info state, rewards, and actions for a player
run_game_cli: run the rl_example module as a CLI tool with --game and --num_players arguments
